video_title: Will MAJOR Injuries END Thunder’s Title Chances? + What Is Going On With Kawhi? & TROUBLE In Miami

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame
quotes.excerpt: Rick Carlisle is just now getting into the Naismith Hall of Fame. It took Bobby coming on

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: When I heard Bobby was going for the Hall of Fame inductions, I was like, this is spectacular. Bobby has been inducted. Secondly, Rick Carlisle is just now getting into the Naismith Hall of Fame. It took Bobby coming on to the committee to get that done.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: Here is the thing. This is year one of the Hall of Fame. This is the first year we have ever had a Hall of Fame, so he is part of the first class.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: A first-ballot induction decades after his career ended.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace injury timelines and recovery
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Williams out for the year with a dislocated ankle and a broken leg. Cason Wallace out indefinitely
quotes.quote: Jalen Williams out for the year with a dislocated ankle and a broken leg. Cason Wallace out indefinitely with a torn labrum. I don't want to get in front of anything, it's typically a four to six-month recovery. This doesn't necessarily end his season, but obviously, it's a terrible injury. Both injuries happening in the same game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Thunder-Clippers screen play and potential foul
quotes.excerpt: I thought that the moving screen was kind of a standard moving screen on Cason Wallace.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Did you think either play was out of line? I just want to get that on the record.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I thought that the moving screen was kind of a standard moving screen on Cason Wallace. Isaiah Jackson set a moving screen on Cason Wallace. Let's be honest, those happen every single game. Isaiah Jackson complained that the call was unfair. He wasn't even looking at Cason Wallace, he was complaining to the referee.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's options for disabled player exceptions following injuries
quotes.excerpt: You will apply for this disabled player exception for Jalen Williams. I don't think you'll get it
quotes.quote: You will apply for this disabled player exception for Jalen Williams. I don't think you'll get it for Cason Wallace because you have to be deemed out until June 15th, and I don't think that Wallace injury will get you there. I think the Jalen Williams injury will. That exception will be worth $15 million. You can always sign or trade for a player in the last year of their contract.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's long-term strategy and salary cap management
quotes.excerpt: The reason that Sam Presti made the trades was because he's taken a long-term view.
quotes.quote: The reason that Sam Presti made the trades was because he's taken a long-term view. They slashed salary now, hoping to be able to spend later because his mission is to have a contender throughout Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's prime. You have a two-time MVP who looked every bit the part of an MVP last night, and you want to be able to contend throughout his prime, and that's going to be expensive, especially when you have two other max players on the roster.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's performance and Thunder's defensive losses
quotes.excerpt: They have lost three all-defensive players by trading Dort, Dub getting injured, and Wallace getting injured.
quotes.quote: They have lost three all-defensive players by trading Dort, Dub getting injured, and Wallace getting injured. And then I don't know how long they'll be without Kawhi Leonard. Obviously, that's not a long-term thing, but just think about the hit they've taken. Three all-defensive wings are no longer part of the equation for the rest of the season, and Wallace for months at least.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's injury history and left knee swelling
quotes.excerpt: The history of injuries that he has had has been to his right knee.
quotes.quote: The history of injuries that he has had has been to his right knee. He's had at least three surgeries on his right knee, including a torn ACL. Although I frankly question whether all of the procedures have been public. This is his left knee, so different. He had not had a significant issue with his left knee in years.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's injury frequency and load management
quotes.excerpt: 47% of the games he's missed has been with the knee, left or right. 173 games.
quotes.quote: 47% of the games he's missed has been with the knee, left or right. 173 games. That is a lot. Average stint per injury at least eight games. So that is the dominant injury. This isn't a left hand here. This is a reoccurring thing. And fortunately, last year he was healthy and he was terrific.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat's offensive struggles and Bam Adebayo's performance
quotes.excerpt: The Heat are scoring 105 points per 100 possessions, which is absolutely not what they were looking for.
quotes.quote: The Heat are scoring 105 points per 100 possessions, which is absolutely not what they were looking for with the Giannis-led offense. Bam Adebayo, this idea that these guys were going to figure it out together. Well, they certainly can. There's 77 games left, but Bam Adebayo cannot score.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of Bam Adebayo on Miami Heat's offensive efficiency
quotes.excerpt: They are minus 13.6 points per 100 with Bam off the floor, they're minus 6.9.
quotes.quote: They are minus 13.6 points per 100 with Bam off the floor, they're minus 6.9. So they're almost seven points better with him off the floor right now.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Clay Thompson's decline and defensive performance
quotes.excerpt: They're starting Clay Thompson, who used to be a great defender, but listen, there's a reason
quotes.quote: They're starting Clay Thompson, who used to be a great defender, but listen, there's a reason the Mavericks pulled Clay from the starting lineup last season. He's a Hall of Famer, first ballot, he's a legend. He's no longer a starter, and he's a poor defensive player at this point in his career. It's not his fault, major injuries, father time. He's a fire hydrant. Also, these guys haven't gotten any kind of rhythm offensively.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo's shooting struggles and offensive role
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo is averaging 12 points a game and I'm rounding up, only shooting 40% overall.
quotes.quote: Bam Adebayo is averaging 12 points a game and I'm rounding up, only shooting 40% overall, which is not his game. Only shooting 16% on threes. Bam Adebayo is taking five threes a game, he's shooting 17%. Andrew Wiggins taking four threes a game, he's shooting 13%. Clay Thompson is taking eight threes a game, he's shooting 33%. Tim Hardaway Jr. is taking five threes a game, he's shooting 19%. Obviously, none of these guys are going to shoot this level, but it's an indication that their offense is not getting stuff going.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Spencer's performance and potential as a starter
quotes.excerpt: Cam Spencer, who is a shooter with a capital S. He's going to get opportunity.
quotes.quote: Cam Spencer, who is a shooter with a capital S. He's going to get opportunity. I anticipate he's going to put up huge numbers. I mentioned the West semifinals, he averaged 22.5 points and six assists in that series. He had 30 points and five assists against the Suns. He's a really, really talented player. If he stays healthy, he's a number two option. I think he's going to put up numbers that are going to have his agent looking at him getting paid, frankly, well north of the number that Cason Wallace got.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Ty Jerome's performance and historical statistical achievement
quotes.excerpt: Ty Jerome became only the fifth player joining Ben Simmons, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor and Maurice Stokes
quotes.quote: Ty Jerome became only the fifth player joining Ben Simmons, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor and Maurice Stokes in NBA history with at least 10 rebounds and four assists in the first three games. Extra possessions with this group here.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart's on-court behavior and punching incident
quotes.excerpt: Did you see him punch his teammate the other day? He was celebrating someone hit a shot
quotes.quote: Did you see him punch his teammate the other day? He was celebrating someone hit a shot and he turned around and punched someone right in the ribs.
